static.solution:
A. 2 x^5 + 2 x^{6} + 2 x^{7} + 2 x^{8} + \cdots is a geometric series with first term 2 x^{5} and ratio x.
B. 2 - 4 + 8 - 16 + 32 - \cdots is a geometric series with first term 2 and ratio -2.
C. 2 x^5 + 3 x^{6} + 4 x^{7} + 5 x^{8} + \cdots is not a geometric series.
